explication: Grounding DINO is a PyTorch open-set object detector: an image and text prompt are prepared, jointly processed by a vision-language detection model, and returned as phrase-labelled boxes that can be visualized. The graph also preserves the repository’s demo and COCO dataset/evaluation branches. Some internal model wiring is inferred from the module structure and README; unsampled details are left out.
